name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 1 campaign ran and delivered 7 leads at a cost per lead of $30.64.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, spending $214.50 across 10,230 impressions and 152 clicks at a click rate of 1.5%.
November 2026 has 27 days left; all $214.50 spent so far this month is on Meta.
The mature 2026-10-05 cohort shows 19 leads, with 15 contacted (78.9%), 5 converted (26.3%), 3 applied (15.8%), and 4 lost after conversion (21.1%) — no one has been hired from it yet.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 23 leads with 17 contacted, 6 converted, 2 applied, and 1 lost after conversion, but it is too young to judge by rates.
The 2026-11-02 cohort, which covers the most recent leads including today's, has 7 leads with only 3 contacted and no conversions yet — also too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
